name: net.art
summary: A loose group of artists of the mid-1990s who used the Internet as a medium and as a place to meet. Their practices differed. Some of them showed together and met on mailing lists.

statement.text: A satirical guide for new internet artists that mixes real tips with a joke about the art world and the identity of the net artist.
statement.title: Introduction to net.art (1994–1999)

moves.text: The term net.art came into use while a project with artists met online was prepared for the exhibition Files at the Bunker in Berlin.
Alexei Shulgin and Natalie Bookchin wrote Introduction to net.art, a satirical manifesto on the movement.
